earlier_broad_validation.scope: Before the final classifier history-dependency and typed-control producer additions; final new cases also ran in the full suite

proven: Completed, failed and cancelled queue receipts keep their original capture deadline; expiry scrubs text, copied name, result and error fields and removes their per-user tracking
Terminal callbacks release closures; late cancellation listeners execute outside the token lock so private cleanup may reenter safely
A revoked pending request is cancelled once without changing unrelated live work; active HTTP/SSE generation cancels on source expiry/revocation and records no successful context

Source-bound cache keys and values are physically pruned on access and in idle maintenance; reads never renew source expiry and defensive copies prevent consumer mutations from changing the retained value
Closed cache admission rejects late writes; a revoked, cancelled or closing vector lookup cannot refill the query cache or issue a subsequent HA action in the connected test graph
Command history uses capture time and the minimum of its configured NLU window and source expiry, rejects a record already outside that window and removes revoked entries
Classifier native generation checks both current-input and included-history sources before native admission and after result return, suppressing invalidated raw output
Native classifier and vector operations remain tracked after observation timeout or caller cancellation; close waits for actual completion rather than abandoning the worker
Both real routing modes record accepted typed controls once with the actual capture UUID, timestamp and deadline, including paths that previously returned before command-history recording
The runtime router owns an idle maintenance task with a nominal one-second interval; reads and publication enforce expiry without waiting for that tick
The source-free CPython 3.13 artifact exercises cache expiry, queue receipt scrubbing and rejection of expired classifier input

latency_failure.diagnosis: A generation-2 GC pause was reproduced during SDK lazy type imports in the constructor worker; the process-wide pause stalls the event loop despite off-loop SDK preparation
latency_failure.next_action: Remove the costly SDK lazy-type initialization from live generation while preserving native streaming, protocol validation, consent and resource ownership; remeasure the unchanged latency limits

limits_and_remaining: The full suite is not green: the 226 ms heartbeat failure remains a required H2/H4 acceptance issue; no limit was widened or test skipped
H3 is incomplete and no coordinated authenticated broad conversation erase is exposed; capture/clip deletion and every affected producer still need durable coordination
Transitive dependencies of general LLM responses on recalled facts and historical context remain incomplete; checking the current capture alone does not prove deletion of every derived response copy
Other diagnostic logs, collectors, streams, frontend copies and alternate caches/persistence still need audit, expiry and source revocation integration
Unconditional privacy authority when the memory catalogue is disabled still requires the broader deletion-service integration; raw deadlines remain enforced in these consumers
Ambient pause, total mute with non-audio reactivation, fingerprint/group retention, manually confirmed voice profiles, voice grouping/review and calibrated acoustic evaluation remain pending
Legacy private-copy migration, actual HA effects and complete runtime/hardware acceptance remain pending; no production data, release or running services were modified
